creator: Reubin Clein

fields.description: Issue includes commentary on the new Miami city commission and the recent commission election (including discussion of H. Leslie Quigg and other candidates), editorials on sex crimes and proposals such as controlled/segregated prostitution districts, and an article asserting press suppression of medical findings linking cigarette smoking to lung cancer (citing Dr. Evarts A. Graham). Additional pieces address utility-rate activism (Utility Subscribers Association), Florida political developments (including George Smathers and Claude Pepper), foreign policy regarding Communist China, and local columns and notices.
